journalNotes.title: Baseline Zero Ready: $50 Seed Tranche Grounded
journalNotes.content: All 48-week targets verified against the $50K compounding roadmap. Starting with untouched $50 seed capital. Strict 0.01 lot calibration and 20-pip stop on Gold XAU/USD. Rule 01 spiritual devotion foundation is locked in before opening charts on Day 1.
